mapper.select: SELECT OM.ORDERNUMBER, CAST(OM.BUILD AS CHAR) AS BUILD, CAST(OM.SPEC AS CHAR) AS SPEC, VDAGENERAL.COUNTRY_OF_OPERATION, OM.CUSTOMER_ADAP, MASTER.LOAD_INDEX, ADCACHANGE.ACT, MODIFICATION.VARIABLE, MODIFICATION.NEWVAL FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_GENERAL VDAGENERAL INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_OM OM ON OM.SERIE = VDAGENERAL.SERIE AND OM.CHNR = VDAGENERAL.CHNR AND OM.TRANS_TS = VDAGENERAL.TRANS_TS INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_TIRE_MASTER MASTER ON VDAGENERAL.TRANS_TS = MASTER.TRANS_TS INNER JOIN HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE ADCACHANGE ON VDAGENERAL.SERIE = ADCACHANGE.SERIE AND VDAGENERAL.CHNR = ADCACHANGE.CHNR LEFT JOIN HDOC_ADCA_MODIFICATION MODIFICATION ON VDAGENERAL.SERIE = MODIFICATION.SERIE AND VDAGENERAL.CHNR = MODIFICATION.CHNO WHERE VDAGENERAL.SERIE = #{series} AND VDAGENERAL.CHNR = #{no}
